abstract: A 35-year-old women developed symptoms of multiple system disease. Three months later she was admitted to hospital and died six days after admission, with signs suggestive of mitral stenosis. Postmortem examination indicated primary chorion carcinoma of the right ovary with metastases to the left atrium, lungs, brain, kidneys, pancreas, mesenteric arteries, and spleen. The signs and symptoms, and the morphological and histological findings at necroscopy, are discussed.
abstract_ja: 35歳の女性が多臓器にわたる症状を呈した。3か月後に入院し、入院6日後に僧帽弁狭窄症を示唆する所見を伴って死亡した。剖検では、右卵巣原発の絨毛癌と、左心房、肺、脳、腎臓、膵臓、腸間膜動脈、脾臓への転移が認められた。臨床症状と所見、ならびに剖検時の形態学的および組織学的所見について考察する。
